expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.F===1 && S.m===1 && S.alku==='levosta' && S.suunta==='oikea' && S.running===false && S.t===0 && S.a===null ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: F = 1,0 N, m = 1,0 kg, from rest, pulled to the right, not running, no measured acceleration yet

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===1 && R[0].min==='0' && R[0].max==='3' && R[0].step==='0.5' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: one slider: F 0-3 N in steps of 0,5

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')].map(s=>[...s.options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')); return L.length===4 && L[0]==='0.5,1,1.5' && L[1]==='levosta,vauhdissa' && L[2]==='oikea,vasen' && L[3]==='0.2,0.4,1' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: selects: mass, initial state, direction of the pull, speed

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Käynnistä' && b[1]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button first; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='F,alku,m,suunta' && P.F.unit==='N' && P.m.unit==='kg' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares F (N), m (kg), alku and suunta

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const n=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth<500; return c.width===600 && (n ? c.height>400 : c.height===400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas is 600 wide: 400 tall on a wide screen, taller (panels stacked) when the sim box is under 500 px
